label: Definition
subgoals: Collect the transitive fanin cone of the node
Keep the nodes whose every fanout lies inside the cone
Count the AND nodes that remain as the MFFC

label: Computing it by dereferencing
subgoals: Initialize reference counts from fanouts and primary outputs
Decrement fanin counts recursively, descending where a count reaches zero
Restore the counts by referencing the visited nodes back

label: Shared logic in the cone
subgoals: Subtract the MFFC size from the cone size
Treat the difference as shared logic that survives replacement
Credit a replacement only with the nodes of the MFFC
